question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The rumours usually _________ like wild fire.
solution:
The correct answer is 'spread.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple present tense and in Active Voice.
 
• Structure: Subject + V1 + s/es(if singular subject) + object (Active Voice)__
 __
 
• *​Example: He plays football. (Active Voice)*
 
 
 
• **V1 form** of '**spread**' is '**spread**'.
 
• **Subject** of the sentence (The rumours) is **plural**, hence we will not use '**s/es**' with V1.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'spread.'

 

Correct Sentence: *The rumours usually **spread__** like wild fire. *
